name: Player
definition: A professional football player recorded in the player master table, identified by a public player API identifier and a FIFA player identifier, with a full display name, a date of birth, a height and a weight.
scope: Player-level analysis over the whole dataset; one row per distinct player.

name: Player Name
definition: The full display name of a player as stored in the player master table. It is a label, not a unique key: several distinct players can carry exactly the same name.
scope: Naming and filtering players; combine with an identifier when the result must be unique.

name: Player Birthday
definition: The player's date of birth, stored as a timestamp with a zero time component. Later dates correspond to younger players.
scope: Age, birth-year and birth-month analysis.

name: Player Age
definition: A player's age in years, computed as the difference between a reference date (for example the current date) and the player's date of birth. No age column is stored; age must be derived.
scope: Age-based comparisons and filtering. The reference date must be stated explicitly.

name: Player Height
definition: The player's standing height recorded as a decimal number of centimetres (values such as 182.88 arise from inch-to-centimetre conversion of the source measurements).
scope: Physical profile and height-threshold filtering.

name: Player Weight
definition: The player's body weight recorded as a whole number of pounds, ranging from 117 to 243 in this dataset.
scope: Physical profile and weight-based ranking.

name: Overall Rating
definition: A dated FIFA-style score on a 0-100 scale expressing the player's current overall ability at the observation date. Values in this dataset range from 33 to 94.
scope: Player quality ranking and strength comparisons.

name: Potential
definition: A dated FIFA-style score on a 0-100 scale expressing the highest overall rating the player is expected to be able to reach. Values in this dataset range from 39 to 97.
scope: Player upside and ceiling comparisons.

name: Preferred Foot
definition: The foot the player preferentially uses, stored as the lower-case text values 'left' or 'right', or null when unrecorded.
scope: Foot-preference filtering and player profiling.

name: Heading Accuracy
definition: A dated 0-100 skill score describing how accurately the player heads the ball.
scope: Skill comparison and ranking; repeated across observation dates.

name: Crossing
definition: A dated 0-100 skill score describing the quality of the player's crosses into the penalty area.
scope: Skill comparison and ranking; repeated across observation dates.

name: Finishing
definition: A dated 0-100 skill score describing the player's shooting accuracy in front of goal.
scope: Skill comparison and ranking; repeated across observation dates.

name: Curve
definition: A dated 0-100 skill score describing how much bend the player imparts to the ball when striking it.
scope: Skill comparison and ranking; repeated across observation dates.

name: Sprint Speed
definition: A dated 0-100 skill score describing the player's top sprinting speed.
scope: Speed comparison and threshold filtering; repeated across observation dates.

name: Jumping
definition: A dated 0-100 skill score describing the player's jumping ability.
scope: Physical skill comparison; repeated across observation dates.

name: Strength
definition: A dated 0-100 skill score describing the player's physical strength in duels.
scope: Physical skill comparison; repeated across observation dates.

name: Long Shots
definition: A dated 0-100 skill score describing the player's ability to shoot accurately from long range.
scope: Skill comparison; repeated across observation dates.

name: Player Attribute Snapshot
definition: A dated evaluation record holding one player's ratings, preferred foot, work rates and skill scores at one observation date. A player has several such records, so a raw attribute value is an observation at a point in time rather than a constant player property.
scope: All attribute, rating and skill analysis. Grain: one player per observation date.

name: Team
definition: A football club that takes part in matches, carrying a public team API identifier, an optional FIFA team identifier, a long club name and a short club code.
scope: Club-level analysis; one row per distinct team (299 teams).

name: Team Long Name
definition: The full textual club name, for example 'KRC Genk' or 'Ajax'. 296 distinct values across 299 teams, so it is nearly but not perfectly unique.
scope: Displaying and filtering teams by name.

name: Team Short Name
definition: A three-letter club abbreviation such as 'GEN', 'AJA' or 'ZUL'. 259 distinct values across 299 teams, so it is not unique.
scope: Compact team labels; not a reliable join key.

name: Team API Identifier
definition: The public team identifier used by the source football API. It is the identifier carried by match home/away team references and by team attribute records.
scope: Joining teams to matches and to team attribute snapshots.

name: Team FIFA Identifier
definition: The FIFA in-game team identifier. Only 285 of the 299 teams carry one, and the values are not unique within the column.
scope: Linking to FIFA-derived team attribute data; not a safe primary key.

name: Team Attribute Snapshot
definition: A dated evaluation record holding a team's tactical ratings and their paired qualitative class labels for build-up play, chance creation and defence. Each team has several such records across six observation dates.
scope: Team tactical style analysis. Grain: one team per observation date.

name: Build Up Play Speed
definition: A dated 0-80 tactical score describing how quickly a team moves the ball forward from defence into attack, ranging from 20 to 80 in this dataset. It is paired with a qualitative speed class (Balanced/Fast/Slow).
scope: Team playing-style comparisons; repeated across observation dates.
aliases: speed in which attacks are put together

name: Chance Creation Passing
definition: A dated 0-80 tactical score describing how much a team creates chances through passing, ranging from 21 to 80. It is paired with a qualitative passing class (Normal/Risky/Safe).
scope: Team playing-style comparisons; repeated across observation dates.

name: League
definition: A domestic football competition belonging to one country, identified by a league identifier and carrying the competition name.
scope: Competition-level analysis; 11 leagues in this dataset.

name: League Name
definition: The textual competition name. Every value begins with the host country name followed by the competition name, for example 'Poland Ekstraklasa' or 'Belgium Jupiler League'.
scope: Displaying and filtering leagues.

name: Country
definition: A country that hosts one or more leagues, identified by a country identifier and carrying the country name.
scope: Country-level analysis; 11 countries in this dataset.

name: Country Name
definition: The plain country name such as 'Poland', 'Belgium' or 'England', without the competition suffix used in league names.
scope: Country filtering and grouping.

name: Match
definition: A single football fixture with a season label, a stage number, a calendar date, a home team, an away team and the final home and away goal counts.
scope: Match-level analysis; 25,979 matches across eight seasons.

name: Season
definition: The competition season a match belongs to, stored as a two-year text label of the form 'YYYY/YYYY' (for example '2015/2016'). There are eight seasons from '2008/2009' to '2015/2016'.
scope: Season filtering and season-level aggregation.

name: Match Stage
definition: The round or matchday number within a season, taking whole values from 1 to 38.
scope: Within-season scheduling analysis.

name: Match Date
definition: The calendar date on which the match was played, stored as a timestamp with a zero time component.
scope: Date-range, month and year filtering of matches.

name: Home Team Goals
definition: The number of goals scored by the home team in a match, a small non-negative integer.
scope: Scoring and result analysis at match grain.

name: Away Team Goals
definition: The number of goals scored by the away team in a match, a small non-negative integer.
scope: Scoring and result analysis at match grain.

name: Match Outcome
definition: The result category of a match: home win, draw, or away win, determined by comparing the home team goal count with the away team goal count. A draw is the case where the two counts are equal.
scope: Result classification and win/draw/loss counting.

name: Match Event Log
definition: Eight text columns storing the per-match event log as XML fragments, one column per event family: goals, shots on target, shots off target, committed fouls, cards, crosses, corners and possession. Each fragment lists per-event player, team, elapsed minute and event subtype.
scope: Event-level match analysis only; the columns are populated for a minority subset of matches.

name: Match Betting Odds
definition: Thirty real-valued columns holding pre-match bookmaker odds arranged as ten bookmakers times the three outcomes home/draw/away. Column identity is positional only and coverage varies strongly by column.
scope: Odds analysis; not usable for general match statistics.

name: Player API Identifier
definition: The public player identifier used by the source football API. It is unique per player in the master table and is the identifier carried by match lineup references.
scope: Joining players to attribute records and match lineups.

name: Player FIFA Identifier
definition: The FIFA in-game player identifier. It is unique in the player master table but the attribute table contains a small number of player rows whose FIFA identifier has no master row.
scope: Joining to FIFA-derived attribute data; slightly less complete than the API identifier.
